parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Using Table 1.1, calculate the percentage increase in prices in the US between April 2015
and January 2016.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Using examples, explain why the prices of products used to calculate the CPI are given
weights.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain why the DPI is more likely to be used for measuring the rate of inflation in the future.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Explain how changes in supply might be the cause of a fall in the price of computers at a
greater rate than the CPI. Use a diagram to support your answer.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text: Explain the implications of inflation for borrowers and savers.

parts.label: (f)
parts.text:
Discuss whether monetary policy can operate effectively if inflation is not measured accurately.

Section B
Answer one question.
